address: 17 rue des Braves (Anse de Maldormé), Marseille, 13007, France
bio: Le Petit Nice is inextricably linked to the city of Marseille and to Gérald Passedat's personality. The heir to a family of artists, the chef was practically born in this restaurant just a stone’s throw from the Mediterranean “that carries and inspires (me)”. The Mediterranean Sea, its fish and shellfish are the backbone of his culinary identity, whose fascinating facets come to the fore in his “Ma Bouille Abaisse”, a signature dish among signature dishes. As you begin to eat, you will appreciate the subtle progression of intense flavours of this bouillabaisse that is both familiar yet complex.
